description: This is a test class for RemoteInsertionImpl, containing unit tests for media request handling, broadcast reception, and lifecycle management within the remote input content insertion feature of the AnySoftKeyboard project.

classes.name: RemoteInsertionImplTest
classes.description: Unit test class for RemoteInsertionImpl, testing lifecycle, media request initiation, broadcast handling, and callback invocation.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test environment, mocks dependencies, and creates instance of RemoteInsertionImpl.

methods.name: testReceiverLifeCycle
methods.description: Verifies that the broadcast receiver is registered upon setup and unregistered after destroy.

methods.name: testStartsPickActivityWithRequest
methods.description: Tests that starting a media request launches the correct intent with proper flags and extras.

methods.name: testCorrectBroadcast
methods.description: Simulates receiving a broadcast with a media URI and verifies callback invocation with correct data.

methods.name: testCorrectBroadcastWithoutRequestMade
methods.description: Ensures that no callback occurs if broadcast is received without a prior request.

methods.name: testIncorrectEmptyIntent
methods.description: Tests handling of an empty intent broadcast, expecting no callback.

methods.name: testIncorrectEmptyDataBroadcast
methods.description: Tests handling of a broadcast with null data, expecting request cancellation callback.

methods.name: testIncorrectRequestBroadcast
methods.description: Verifies that a broadcast with mismatched request ID does not trigger callback.

methods.name: createReceiverIntent
methods.description: Helper method to create intents for broadcast simulation with specified parameters.

methods.name: fakeProxy
methods.description: Mock implementation of media proxy returning a fixed URI response.
